final_message:
I fixed the bug in `revenue_between` in `billing/reports.py`. It added credit notes to the amount paid instead of subtracting them, so a refunded invoice counted double. The line now reads `net = invoice["amount_paid"] - credited`.

The full suite passes (24 tests). I didn't add your reproduction test to the suite, so that exact test wasn't run.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root: `{"file": "reports.py", "function": "revenue_between"}`.

When an invoice was partly paid with account credit, the refund's credit note includes that credit amount. That would make net revenue for the invoice lower than the cash collected. I didn't change this, because your test only covers a fully cash-paid invoice.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat reports.py && grep -n "def refund" -A40 *.py

cd .. && sed -i 's/net = invoice\["amount_paid"\] + credited/net = invoice["amount_paid"] - credited/' billing/reports.py && echo '{"file": "reports.py", "function": "revenue_between"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
